title: API Performance Testing: How to Design Realistic Tests
why_read: A solid, practical overview of designing realistic performance tests covers useful fundamentals but doesn't offer much beyond standard advice for experienced engineers.
analysis: This article covers the basics of performance testing, including how to define realistic load scenarios, handle external service dependencies, and match test environments to production. It's a reasonably thorough introduction to designing performance tests that yield meaningful, actionable results rather than misleading numbers. The content is useful for engineers newer to performance testing but likely too basic for those already experienced in this area.
